name: Smooth.iff_forall_exists_isStandardSmooth
statement: X ⟶ Y) : Smooth f ↔ ∀ (x : X), ∃ (U : Y.Opens) (_ : IsAffineOpen U) (V : X.Opens) (_ : IsAffineOpen V) (_ : x ∈ V) (e : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U), (f.appLE U V e).hom.IsStandardSmooth

name: formallySmooth_stalkMap_iff
statement: X ⟶ Y} {x : X} (U : Y.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (V : X.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hVU : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (hx : x ∈ V) : letI

name: exists_smooth_of_formallySmooth_stalk
statement: X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (x : X) (H : (f.stalkMap x).hom.FormallySmooth) : ∃ (U : Y.Opens) (_ : IsAffineOpen U) (V : X.Opens) (_ : IsAffineOpen V) (hVU : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U), x ∈ V ∧ (f.appLE U V hVU).hom.Smooth

have_tree.body: (formallySmooth_stalkMap_iff U hU V hV hVU hxV).mp H

name: Scheme.Hom.mem_smoothLocus
statement: X ⟶ Y} [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] {x : X} : x ∈ f.smoothLocus ↔ (f.stalkMap x).hom.FormallySmooth

name: Scheme.Hom.smoothLocus_eq_top_iff
statement: X ⟶ Y} [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] : f.smoothLocus = ⊤ ↔ Smooth f

name: Scheme.Hom.genericPoint_mem_smoothLocus_of_perfectField
statement: Type u} [Field K] [PerfectField K] [IsIntegral X] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] : genericPoint X ∈ f.smoothLocus

name: Scheme.Hom.dense_smoothLocus_of_perfectField
statement: Type u} [Field K] [PerfectField K] [IsReduced X] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] : Dense (f.smoothLocus : Set X)
